additional_info.subject: ID0481228-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002722] Logs check on charger CRM:02681001511
additional_info.body:
Dear Manuela,
Thank you for confirming the timestamp regarding the charging session.
We see that this charging session was connected to the AC outlet, and the authorization was causing an error.
We also see that during this charging session the car was not asking any voltage from the charger, so the charger also didn`t provide this to the car.
You can see in the logs that the request was 0, and the charger was because of that also providing 0.
We hope to have informed you enough regarding this request.
Please provide us with feedback, so we can close this ticket.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
